correctness.rationale: Direct structural lower bound: the 32 distinct girth-seven cycles meet any vertex at most 10 times, so three vertices cover at most 30. A second independent BFS-girth enumeration of all 2024 triple deletions and 10626 quadruple deletions confirms the theorem, every residual girth is eight, and 16+4 components with 32 exchange edges. All scripts are complete, stdlib-only and replayed from local paths.

value.rationale: Deleting the fewest vertices necessary to increase girth is a natural extremal robustness measure for the unique non-Moore cubic (3,7)-cage. The full solution-space geometry is nontrivial: a 4-dimensional mobile cubical family coexists with four completely exchange-frozen optima. This sharp distinction would be invisible from the classical 24-vertex/7-girth/symmetry data and is useful as an exact benchmark for shortest-cycle hitting and constrained configuration mobility.
